scope: V0 current-state profile for trusted operational governance implementation
environment: connected Supabase production project and GitHub main branch

current_profile_findings.evidence: Control definitions and scope bindings exist, but no live control evaluations are persisted.
AI evaluation schema exists, but no live evaluation results are persisted.
Retention policy schema exists, but no live retention policy is configured.
Transformation evidence exists, but live lineage_column_mappings is empty.
Quality rule definitions, versions and runs are populated, but no governed quality-rule exception is exercised.
Profile comparison history exists, but no live profile anomaly evidence is persisted.
Glossary terms, CDEs, CDE mappings, stewardship assignments and control definitions are populated.
Quality rule definitions, versions and execution history are populated, with canonical result-state hardening present on main.

review_required.note: Membership helper functions in app_private are SECURITY DEFINER and executable by authenticated. Confirm this is intentional and minimally scoped before V1 closure.
Leaked password protection is disabled and should be reviewed as part of secure-release posture.

informational.note: Several internal/service-oriented tables have RLS enabled with no policies. Verify they are intentionally service-only rather than automatically adding permissive policies.
The findings are in jdbc_test.customer_data and profiling_validation.synthetic_customers; review as test-fixture hygiene rather than production-domain blockers.
Do not remove indexes based on a single low-usage snapshot. Reassess only with representative workload evidence.

repository_release_posture.note: Secure release governance should require protected main and required checks before final trusted-platform certification.

interpretation: V0 confirms that DataNexus already has broad governance schema and execution substrate. The implementation program should activate and integrate existing capabilities rather than create parallel infrastructure.
